title: Recover implied subjects
subtitle: Let verb endings and nearby nouns reveal who acts.
overview: Greek often omits a subject pronoun because the verb ending already identifies the person and number. Context supplies which named person or group is meant.
Do not add “he” or “they” by instinct. Trace the nearest compatible noun and keep a referent note when two options remain.

items.grc: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ἀκολούθειτέ μοι.

items.en: They believed the Lord, and they rejoiced.
